notes.lambda_mu: recorded for reproducibility; no routing decision uses them yet

uncertainty_definition_detail.uncertainty: normalized predictive entropy: -sum_c p_c ln(p_c) / ln(K)
uncertainty_definition_detail.margin: p_(1) - p_(2), the top-1 minus top-2 probability
uncertainty_definition_detail.note: Entropy is a property of the predictive distribution, not a calibrated probability of correctness. Calibration is measured separately in src.ahsef.calibration and reported alongside, never assumed.

definition.latency_ms: measured mean per-sample feature extraction + forward pass
definition.compute_units: parameters x input_elements, a MAC-order proxy, not a FLOP count
definition.normalization: each quantity divided per the 'max' rule over the candidate set being ranked

modality_emotion_table.note: Cells are per-class scores on each modality's own test partition. Those partitions are different sample sets drawn from different corpora, so a column comparison indicates which modality is stronger for an emotion in this project's data, not a per-sample complementarity.
